It's broken too here...\nThe previous god in this shrine is gone and it\nseems that the new god didn't make one either...
Hey, Arrol...
Hey, Arrol... What are you so busy with?!
Oh, yes?
Ah, sorry.\nUnbelievable things are everywhere,\nthis place is just too marvelous for me...
Oh yeah? Good for you...
Oh yeah? Good for you...\nI mean, where are the gods that are supposed to be\nin this shrine?
Oh, you mean the Construction Gods right.\nThere are actually 5 of them, but Specia\nthe Goddess of Species passed away long ago.

So her shrine should be somewhere else.
The gods here are the God of Earth,
the Goddess of Water, the God of Fire,
and the Goddess of Wind...
Aren't they all the gods that possess the\nessential elements to shape the world??
Now that they're gone, is our world gonna be fine\nthough?!
Who knows...\nBut since no natural disasters happen in\nparticular, we should be fine, right?
Because although they're not here, they might be\nsomewhere else...
Hey! How could you be so chill?!
Well...it's not completely wrong though.\nIt's true that there're no natural disasters...
We have no choice but to proceed further to find\nout about it. Let's go guys!
Heyy! Please waiiit!\nPlease help me carry the files I collected hereee!
There are 2 chambers in the Special Gods Shrine.\nDunkelis', the Goddess of Darkness & Oritius', the\nGod of War. There's a throne in both chambers...
Why?? Why are there 2 thrones?\nI've never seen such gods in our world...
Oh, yeah. I see.\nYou've met Dunkelis in the Dark Realm before,\nthat means such gods do exist...
What?! You've met Dunkelis in the Dark Realm?!\nWhat do you mean?! Please story me!!
You told him roughly about getting rescued from\nmonsters by Grecia the Goddess of Courage at\nLunagent Mountain and
saving Dunkelis by fighting a mysterious presence\nthat was threatening the Dark Realm...
Wow!! You went and came back from the Dark Realm?\nWhat an amazing adventurer you are!!
The Dark Realm may seem like a different world,\nbut it is said that it is connected to this world.
Since Dunkelis is doing fine in the Dark Realm,\nher throne remains here...
But what about the other god, Oritius...?\nWas he in the Dark Realm too by any chance?
From what we learnt about Pino, Kunon and Dunkelis,\nit can be assumed that Oritius is also here in\nthis world...but where?
There's no use thinking about it here.\nLet's go and investigate the rest of the ruins!
Still, how could all this...First, the cataclysm\nbeing an invasion from the outer world, then such\ngrotesque creatures hiding here since then...
What's worse is seeds of disaster have been sown\nsomewhere not very far from this world...
I'd say that most of the things that don't\nmake sense happening in the human world and the\nDark Realm are all their doing...
In that case, I guess the fact that Almas and the\nother gods went missing could also be related to\nthem...
Oh?! Mr. Wanderer...I mean God of War!!
Oritius!! Where have you been all this...
O-Oritius?! Oh, yea, right!!
It's been a while! I'll tell you about me later...\nI came back here because I had a bad feeling.\nLooks like this mess is not a trivial matter.
Besides, I can sense that something is still\nloitering in that mysterious corridor...
Something?
Oh!!
What's wrong munchkin?!
Not munchkin, but Pelulu! Remember that creature\nsaid that they were going home, right?
Could that mean that it's going back to its world,\nbut its fellows are still here in this world...?
Hmm...that means although we have recaptured\nEldenbaum, we shouldn't be careless or let our\nguard down yet...
Well, this is gonna be fun...Challenge accepted!\nAlong with the whole Dark Troop, I'll make sure to\nwipe out every single one of them!
But in the end, we know nothing about Coenubia...\nPerhaps, the key to solve all the mysteries is in\nthe world they've returned to...Toram...
Well at least Coenubia's stem sphere has\nretreated for now.
Before they attack again, I guess we should think\nabout how to maintain this world that has become\nunstable due to the loss of gods' power...
Maybe we'll be fine as long as a special god like\nyou stays with us.
Let's go back to the Dark Realm to look closely\ninto the matter and set up a plan! Will you help\nus?
I couldn't wish for anything better.\nSince I'd like to make up for the troubles I've\ncaused in the past too, please let me help!!
I bet you've heard that we're returning to the\nDark Realm, but before that, we'll send you to the\npeople waiting for you. Where would you return to?
Really?! But, where should we return to tho?
Ah right, before I came here, I saw some people\nyou know gathering in Dikkit Sector.
Captain Rieno should be there too. If you don't\nmind, please let him know that I'm going somewhere\nfar and I'll definitely come back to see him.
W-well, to Dikkit Sector then...
Anyway, wanderer...
Anyway, wanderer...oops, I mean Oritius, don't you\nthink Captain Rieno will be surprised if he finds\nout that you're going to the Dark Realm?
Fine, I'll send you to Dikkit Sector then.\nAre you ready?\nNow, close your eyes...
